title: Use the review-scoped finite bath without inferring a storage bath
statement: At the acquired review own stated scope, a finite oscillator chain in its own Gibbs state plus calibrated local vacua/Gaussian forces supplies the conditional clock-preparation approximation with paid bath-size, occupation, coefficient, time and precision budgets. The microscopic finite-time bridge is not a fixed-coupling long-storage or local fault-budget theorem. Later unpinned reservoir edits have not automatically inherited this acceptance.
